entities.name: Janīna Kursīte-Pakule
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Janīna Kursīte-Pakule is a Latvian literary scholar, linguist, writer, publicist, and politician. She has served as deputy of the 9th, 10th, 11th, and 12th Saeimas. Kursīte-Pakule is a member of the Latvian Academy of Sciences.
